MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

3. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

4. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 3

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

7. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 11
   D. 29

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 0

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 7

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 5

12. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

13. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

14. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 0

15. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

16. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
